steps.text: Central board with the 2-4 Players side up
All tokens in the Pouch next to the Central board
Fill each of the 5 Central board spaces with 3 random tokens
Shuffle the Animal cards; 5 faceup next to the board, the rest as a draw pile; Animal cubes within reach
Each player takes a Personal board (everyone on the same side) and the matching Reminder card
steps.note: First games: Side A; leave the Nature's Spirit cards in the box

steps.text: Whoever last saw a magnificent landscape is first; point the Central board's arrow at them
From the first player clockwise, take your turn's actions in any order
